notes.title: November 2nd Patch Notes
notes.notes:
-Fixed an issue with auto mode not properly waiting until the character finishes speaking.
-Fixed a bug that caused voiced text in the main window to display very quickly regardless of speed settings.
(TSL Ver1.04)

notes.title: June 1st Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Updates:

-The problems on low resolution displays involving graphic abnormalities and misaligned mouse locations are entirely fixed.
-Added the ability to switch between windowed and full-screen mode in the options menu.

notes.title: April 3rd Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Updates:
- Fixed a bug that caused the game screen to be cut off and mouse clicks to not be detected at the edge of the screen when played in full screen at a low resolution.
- Some spelling and grammar corrections.

notes.title: February 24th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Updates:　
- Corrected the issue of auto mode going too fast.
- Fixed unresponsive UI buttons during auto mode playback.
- Corrected the problem of the automatic quick save option not working despite being selected in the options menu.
- Fixed some spelling & grammatical errors.
- Adjusted the quality of some music and sound effects.
